name: Nadezhda umiraet poslednej
source:
Sovyonok. From the outside, the camp is quiet, cute, and cozy, unlike Artek. You could say that the pioneers are completely safe and secure in this place... At least, that is what everyone thought until today. It is Semyon who uncovers the terrifying truth. It is Semyon who does not lose hope and pursues his goal. In pursuit of it, he learns about the threat looming over the camp. What will he do? Will he run away? Will he fight? Will he perish? Everything will depend on the decisions our protagonist makes as events unfold.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1589756097]Steam[/url]]
